input_cap_includes: System and user prompts, schemas, retrieval, prior messages, and all tool-result context; use conservative provider quota estimates rather than billed tokens alone
traffic_shaping: Twenty turns per minute in the declared mix; maximum ten concurrent clients. The Phase10 dispatcher must enforce both rolling RPM and estimated TPM, with headroom, and count queuing in the full-answer latency.
not_guaranteed: Ten concurrent turns each making three calls at the global 12000/1500 token ceilings cannot fit this deployment. The global ceilings are safety limits, not the nominal load profile.
scope_preserved: All 100 benchmark completions, ten concurrent clients, exact frozen case mix, errors/timeouts and strict full-answer p95<15000ms remain. No first-token substitution, hidden queue time, dropped cases, unreported prompt truncation or Global geography fallback.
phase10_hold_point: Measure complete prompts including quota estimates before load. If a case cannot fit its intent cap without losing necessary evidence, or quota shaping misses the latency/error/quality criteria, request DataZone quota/capacity and reprice before proceeding; never weaken the benchmark to force a pass.
retry_policy: At most one separately reserved retry per turn, within the three-total-call and whole-turn deadline limits. Twenty percent headroom is not a promise of serving an all-callers retry storm. Deterministic 429 and fail-closed cases are tested locally.
